8 احتجم He performed the operation of cupping: (MA, KL, PS:) [or rather he had that operation performed upon him; or had blood drawn from him by that operation; a quasi-pass. verb, like افتصد and اكتوى and احترق and countless others:] or he sought, or demanded, the performance of that operation [upon himself]. (K TA.) One says, اِحْتَجَمْتُ مِنَ الدَّمِ [app. meaning I had some of the blood drawn from me by cupping]. (S.) ＝
-A2- He (a camel) was withheld, or restrained, or prevented, from biting [by being muzzled]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
